description: This PHP script is part of the TestLink open-source test management tool. It generates a report showing test execution results and progress by tester per build, including data aggregation, table generation, and user input handling.

classes.name: tlUser
classes.description: Class representing a user, with methods for permission checks.

classes.name: TLSmarty
classes.description: Class for rendering templates with Smarty integration.

classes.name: tlExtTable
classes.description: Class representing an extended table component for displaying data.

methods.name: init_args
methods.description: Initializes and processes user input arguments, handling access rights and fetching project and plan info.

methods.name: init_gui
methods.description: Initializes GUI display data based on provided arguments, setting page title and related info.

methods.name: getTableHeader
methods.description: Builds table header configuration with columns for build info, user, test case counts, statuses, progress, and total time.

methods.name: minutes2HHMMSS
methods.description: Converts decimal minutes into HH:MM:SS format, accurately handling fractional minutes.
